questions.subject: General Aptitude
questions.question:
The author said, "Musicians rehearse before their concerts. Actors rehearse their roles before the opening of a new play. On the other hand, I find it strange that many public speakers think they can just walk onto the stage and start speaking. In my opinion, it is no less important for public speaker to rehearse their talks."

Based on the above passage, which one of the following is $\text{TRUE}$?
questions.rawQuestionHtml:
The author said, "Musicians rehearse before their concerts. Actors rehearse their roles before the opening of a new play. On the other hand, I find it strange that many public speakers think they can just walk onto the stage and start speaking. In my opinion, it is no less important for public speaker to rehearse their talks."

Based on the above passage, which one of the following is $\text{TRUE}$?

  1. The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is important for musicians, actors and public speakers
  2. The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is less important for public speakers than for musicians and actors
  3. The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is more important only for musicians than public speakers
  4. The author is of the opinion that rehearsal is more important for actors than musicians
options: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is important for musicians, actors and public speakers
The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is less important for public speakers than for musicians and actors
The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is more important only for musicians than public speakers
The author is of the opinion that rehearsal is more important for actors than musicians

structuredOptions.label: A
structuredOptions.text: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is important for musicians, actors and public speakers
structuredOptions.html: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is important for musicians, actors and public speakers

structuredOptions.label: B
structuredOptions.text: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is less important for public speakers than for musicians and actors
structuredOptions.html: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is less important for public speakers than for musicians and actors

structuredOptions.label: C
structuredOptions.text: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is more important only for musicians than public speakers
structuredOptions.html: The author is of the opinion that rehearsing is more important only for musicians than public speakers

structuredOptions.label: D
structuredOptions.text: The author is of the opinion that rehearsal is more important for actors than musicians
structuredOptions.html: The author is of the opinion that rehearsal is more important for actors than musicians
